resources.string: One of you creates the space, the other joins it with a code. Only the two of you can ever read what is inside.
These words are the key to your data. If both phones are lost and you do not have them, nothing can be recovered — not by us, not by anyone. Write them on paper and keep them somewhere safe.
Ask your partner to open the app and read out the code it shows.
You have joined the space. Your partner needs to approve this phone before it can read anything — ask them to tap approve, then check again.
Type the 24 words you wrote down when this space was created, separated by spaces, in order.
Let your partner scan this code, or read it out to them. It works once and expires in 24 hours.
This phone joined your space. Approve it only if you recognise it — approving hands it the key to everything.
No connection. Check your internet and try again.
The server took too long to answer. Try again.
That code is not valid. It may have expired or already been used.
This space already has two people in it.
This phone could not open the key it was given.
That phrase is not valid. Check the words and try again.
You will need to sign in again to try a different account.
